Needs changes before merge.

The machine registration check and the icon checks pass. The site icons and license notice match the app.

I reviewed this head against upstream/main `7b4dc0d8995d79a0b783271d4e99c08f32f27e2a`. The local trial merge required no changes.

Local results:
- The two repair tests pass.
- The complete GuideIcons suite passes: 3 tests. This includes the Zola build test.
- The full site suite runs 47 tests. It reports 1 failure and 6 errors.
- The quick gate passes with 0 applicable Rust steps. The dry run gives the same plan.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD` passes.
- Rust crate builds and Clippy do not apply. No Rust crate changed.

Requested before merge:
1. `site/tests/test_first_4axis_part.py:62`: Update the stale tool-number label and the matching guide text at `site/content/guide/getting-started/first-4axis-part.md:126`. The app now draws `Tool number (0 = next free)`. The test still expects `Tool number (0 = list position)`. This existing failure remains in the touched suite. Issue #2345 explicitly requires a green full site suite. Run that suite with Node available and record the result before this PR closes the issue.

Failure summary:
```text
FAIL: test_each_bold_ui_label_is_a_string_in_its_source
      (label='Tool number (0 = list position)')
Ran 47 tests
FAILED (failures=1, errors=6)
```

The six errors come from search subtests. This machine has no `node` executable. These errors are an environment limit, not six code findings.

This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, collision checks, gouge checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. Safety mutations do not apply. I did not run mutations or change the PR code. No `crates/ui` file changed, so UI screenshots are not required.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: The stale tool-number label in the first 4-axis guide and its test now reads `Tool number (0 = next free)`, matching the app.

Pinned by `FirstFourAxisPart.test_each_bold_ui_label_is_a_string_in_its_source`. Reverting the guide correction fails the pin; restoring it passes. Reverting the test mapping fails the pin; restoring it passes.

The full site suite passes: 47 tests with Node v22.16.0 and Zola available. `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passes with zero applicable Rust steps. Clippy does not apply because no Rust crate changed. `git diff --check` passes.

New head: `78736bd6bf91d76465cea2a2ff130ea45272c401`.

Please re-review this head.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

I reviewed this head against current upstream/main `37bde5e9a` and its AGENTS.md. The local trial merge had no conflicts.

The earlier requested change is complete. The guide and its test use `Tool number (0 = next free)`, as the app does. The full site suite now passes.

Local results:
- `python3 -m unittest discover -s site/tests -v`: 47 tests pass. Node v22.16.0 was on the test process PATH. Zola 0.23.6 was available.
- The machine registration test checks the current registry and the shipped machine filename.
- The icon tests confirm that the site icons and license notice match the app. The Zola build checks pass.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: 0 applicable Rust steps.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passes, 0 steps and 0 failures.
- `git diff --check upstream/main...HEAD`: passes.
- Rust crate builds and Clippy do not apply. No Rust crate changed.

Requested before merge: none.

Note: The PR body's “Not exercised” section and the decision record still describe the earlier failed suite. The author's later comment and this review record the passing result.

This PR does not change posted G-code, geometry, gouge checks, collision checks, or stock simulation. No goldens moved. Safety mutations do not apply. I ran no mutations and changed no PR code. No crates/ui file changed, so before/after UI screenshots are not required.
